sound_categories.name: Machinery Fault
sound_categories.recommended_action: Schedule urgent mechanical inspection for vibrating or irregular machinery component.
sound_categories.description: Bearing faults, motor cavitation, grinding gears, or abnormal machine hum.

sound_categories.name: Glass Breaking
sound_categories.recommended_action: Check perimeter cameras and dispatch security patrol to verified sector.
sound_categories.description: Window shatters, glass partition breakage, or forced entry sounds.

sound_categories.name: Alarm or Siren
sound_categories.recommended_action: Verify alarm zone panel and initiate facility evacuation / emergency response.
sound_categories.description: Fire alarms, industrial hazard klaxons, emergency siren sweeps.

sound_categories.name: Vehicle Horn
sound_categories.recommended_action: Log traffic incident for environmental monitoring.
sound_categories.description: Car, truck, or forklift horns in loading docks or roadway perimeters.

sound_categories.name: Animal Sound
sound_categories.recommended_action: Record event in environmental audit log.
sound_categories.description: Barking dogs, stray animals, bird distress calls.

sound_categories.name: Gunshot
sound_categories.recommended_action: IMMEDIATE FACILITY LOCKDOWN, TRIGGER EMERGENCY LIGHTS, AND CONTACT POLICE.
sound_categories.description: Ballistic impulse, gunshot discharge, high-energy acoustic crack.

sound_categories.name: Panic Scream
sound_categories.recommended_action: DISPATCH ON-SITE GUARDS AND MEDICAL SQUAD TO AUDIO LOCATION.
sound_categories.description: High-pitch human distress screams, panic vocalisations.

sound_categories.name: Aggression
sound_categories.recommended_action: Deploy crowd control / security presence to de-escalate confrontation.
sound_categories.description: Violent shouting, hostile verbal altercation, banging and physical struggle sounds.

sound_categories.name: Person Asking for Help
sound_categories.recommended_action: DISPATCH FIRST RESPONDER TO AID CALLER IN DISTRESS.
sound_categories.description: Spoken distress calls such as 'Help me', 'Somebody help', 'Emergency', 'Call for help'.

sound_categories.name: Background Noise
sound_categories.recommended_action: None required - filtered as ambient environmental noise.
sound_categories.description: HVAC hum, wind, rain, distant conversation, computer fan noise.

sound_categories.name: Test Drone Buzz
sound_categories.recommended_action: Check sky perimeter for unmanned aerial vehicle.

sound_categories.name: Drone
sound_categories.description: Custom trained acoustic category (35 clips validated & extracted).
